articles.title: The Mossos admit that the police presence did not manage to dissuade the riots
articles.description: "It did not take us by surprise, the facts disprove it." With these words, the general director of the police, Ferran López, denied that the Mossos d'Esquadra did not expect the disturbances on Saturday in Barcelona. The demonstration had a level 2 out of 3 and, as this newspaper has already been explaining, they carried out 300 identifications of young people before the call and also seized hammers, pyrotechnics, sprays, stones, and balaclavas. There had already been some previous demonstrations of the Blocus style, one in Manresa, for example, without incidents. But the police were indeed surprised by the violence of the young people. "We did not correctly gauge the degree of violence, we had never seen it before," admitted López before an opposition that criticized the Mossos for not having sufficiently foreseen this scenario.
